message_text: why did tuition go up 8% this year? that's way above inflation
The tuition increase reflects investments in new campus facilities, faculty hiring, and technology infrastructure upgrades. The Board of Trustees approved the increase in April.
that doesnt help students who are already struggling to pay. was there any student input?
The Student Government Association was consulted during the budget process. A student town hall was held in March.
nobody knew about that town hall. the communication at this school is terrible
I understand your frustration. I'll share your feedback about improving communication around tuition decisions. You can also attend SGA meetings which are open to all students.
